ux_dom.dom.src.concurrency.doc: Per-tree locks + parallel rendering with **opt-in / opt-out** policy.

build_parallel.doc: Map ``fn`` over any iterable — parallel when policy allows, else sequential.
build_parallel.signature: (fn: Callable[[T], R], items: Iterable[T], *, max_workers: Optional[int]=None, parallel: Optional[bool]=None) -> list[R]

configure_concurrency.doc: Opt-in / opt-out parallel behaviour without changing call sites.
configure_concurrency.signature: (*, parallel_enabled: Optional[bool]=None, max_workers: Optional[int]=None, min_items_for_parallel: Optional[int]=None, tree_locks_enabled: Optional[bool]=None, reset_pool: bool=True) -> ConcurrencySettings

default_workers.doc: Sensible worker count (min 2, max 32), honoring ``max_workers`` policy.

multi_tree_lock.doc: Acquire root locks (no-op context if tree locks disabled by policy).

render_async_gather.doc: Async render many trees; sequential await when parallel policy is off.
render_async_gather.signature: (nodes: Sequence[Any], *, pretty: bool=False, chunk_size: int=64, parallel: Optional[bool]=None) -> list[str]

render_parallel.doc: Render many trees — parallel when policy allows, else sequential.
render_parallel.signature: (nodes: Sequence[Any], *, pretty: bool=False, max_workers: Optional[int]=None, parallel: Optional[bool]=None) -> list[str]

reset_concurrency_settings.doc: Restore settings from environment (tests / process recycle).

root_of.doc: Walk ``parent`` links to the tree root (cycle-safe).

should_parallelize.doc: Whether multi-item helpers should use a pool (policy + kwargs).
should_parallelize.signature: (n_items: int, *, max_workers: Optional[int]=None, parallel: Optional[bool]=None) -> bool

tree_lock_for.doc: Return the re-entrant lock for ``node``'s tree root.
